player_prompt.intro:
I ni kanu kɛmɛ Lights Out! I bɛ {size}x{size} lajɛ kɔnɔ.
I bɛɛ nɛnɛ kɛmɛ ka dugu kɔnɔ kɛmɛnɛ dugu wɛrɛwɛrɛ ('.').
I si tɛmɛnɛ dugu kɔnɔ, a tɛmɛnɛ a yɛrɛ ma a bɛɛ tɛmɛnɛ a kɔnɔniwɛrɛwɛrɛ (kɔrɔnɛ/kɔrɔnɛ/kɔɲɛ/kɔɲɛ).
I kɛmɛ [row col] ka tɛmɛnɛ dugu kɔnɔ (0-kɔnɔsɛbɛnɛ, kɔrɔ 0-{max_index}).
I bɛɛ {max_turns} kɛmɛ ka wuli pɛrɛpɛrɛ.
Kɛmɛ: 'O' = dugu kɔnɔ, '.' = dugu wɛrɛ

invalid_move.wrong_format: A be kɛ cogo la [row col] ni kɔri ani kolon ye nimero dafalenw ye ka bɔ 0 na fɔɔ ka taga se {max_index} ma.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kɔɔrdɔnɛ bɛɛ kɛna 0 ɲɛ {max_index} kɔnɔ. I kɛlɛ [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: I ye jigitigi jaabi ni {moves_used}fɔli ye!
